name: Wanted Sketch
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Janitor Thief – Change the hair into a janitor cap and confirm. House Intruder – Turn the portrait into a dark shadow figure with glowing eyes.
Pervert Stalker – Use short blonde hair, a creepy smile, and red sunglasses.
Romance Scammer – Switch to a female, add long brown hair, makeup, and a red top.
Embezzling Secretary – Use a blonde bob hairstyle and a blue office suit.
Impostor Cop – Switch to a male, make him bald with an angry face, and add a police uniform.
